subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this remain the canonical umbrella, or should maintainers split the remaining work into separately owned designs for metrics, cross-session recall defaults, conversation continuation, and restart preload?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes would add user-facing API/config/default and privacy-sensitive session-state surfaces; automation cannot choose those product and security boundaries safely.

options.title: Split into design-backed issues
options.body: Create or bless narrower issues for metrics, cross-session recall policy, continuation semantics, and restart preload while keeping this issue as the umbrella index.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the single canonical tracker and require maintainer-written acceptance criteria before any implementation PR.

options.title: Defer until memory stabilizes
options.body: Pause new surface work until active memory and session-memory reliability issues settle, then revisit the default and API shape.

recommendation.title: Split into design-backed issues
recommendation.body: Create or bless narrower issues for metrics, cross-session recall policy, continuation semantics, and restart preload while keeping this issue as the umbrella index.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across memory, usage, and the prior issue review, making him the best routing owner for the product-scope decision.
